structs.notes: Partial. Replay code that fills or reads this cache was not found. The game-test generator R_GenerateWorldTransientCache clears 0x39000 bytes (DebugWipe) and copies per zone into drawVerts[i] (32-byte moves, 4 per element = 128-byte stride) and drawCells at 196608 + 24*i; those are game-test facts, not Replay proof. Replay has one related fact: Mark_GfxWorldDraw (0x140d9d860, 578 bytes) walks 0x600 zone pointers at GfxWorldDraw+392, which supports 1536 zone slots on the world-draw side only. Lower bound 0 (no Replay access), upper bound not established. The cache is held by value in a parent that IDA does not type (frontEndData or the FX mark world cell cache); finding that parent would give the size as a member distance (method 6).
